Chamarajanagara, registered for offences punishable under Sections 376(2)(n), Sections 5(J)(II),
5(L) and 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 (in short 'POCSO Act') and Section 9 of the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act 2006.

sentences.text:
6. On a complaint by the Woman Supervisor and Child Marriage Prohibition Officer, Kollegala,
aforementioned case was registered against the petitioner.

The report submitted by the complainant would reveal that the matter was informed to her by the Medical Officer, Primary Health Center,
Martalli Village, when the victim girl came to the Primary Health Center for checkup and noticing that she was pregnant and still a minor.
As per prosecution, date of birth of the victim is 10.09.2005 and she was aged about 18 years and 5 months when she was found pregnant.
It is contended by the learned HCGP that the victim girl was a minor as on the date of commission of the offence and therefore, there is a prima-facie case against the petitioner.

8. The prosecution is relying on the certificate issued by the Head Master of Government Higher and Primary School, Soolavadi, Martalli Village, Hannur Taluk, Chamarajanagar District and 1st standard school register to prove the age.

However, learned counsel for the petitioner has disputed the date of birth of the victim girl as mentioned in those documents contending that no authentic documents are collected to establish the correct age of the victim.
9. The prosecution has to establish the age of the victim during the trial, in accordance with law.
Investigation is completed and charge sheet is already filed.
Petitioner is aged 20 years.
He is in judicial custody NC: 2025:KHC:503 since 29.02.2024.
Considering the facts and circumstances, by imposing suitable conditions, relief sought by the petitioner can be granted.

Accordingly, the following:
ORDER i) The criminal petition is allowed.
ii) Petitioner/accused in Spl.C.No.111/2024 on the file of the Court of Additional District and Sessions Judge and FTSC-I, Chamarajanagara (Crime No.392/2024 of Ramapura Police Station, Chamarajanagara) shall be enlarged on bail, subject to following conditions:
a) He shall execute a personal bond for a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with two sureties for the likesum to the satisfaction of the Jurisdictional Court.
b) He shall furnish proof of his residential address and shall inform the Investigation Officer/Court, if there is any change in the address.
